# AMC Folder Tab

<!-- Generated by tools/build-templates.mjs from template.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Region Template** for Universal Theme · direction: bold · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

The region is a physical file folder: a trapezoid tab with the icon and title rises from the top edge, and the content sits on a sheet of grained paper tucked into a manila or palette-colored folder, optionally with more sheets peeking out behind it.

**Use it for:** Record-centred regions that read like a file: a customer or supplier Form, a contract or case summary in Static Content, the lines of an order in a Classic Report or Interactive Report, or a small Chart in a dossier page.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, through the Builder):** App Builder > your app > Shared Components >
  Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_tpl_folder_tab.sql` (Component Export). It creates the
  template in Universal Theme and its Static Application File(s) in `amc-templates/`.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/region-templates/amc-folder-tab.apx` and
  `dist/apexlang/shared-components/static-files/amc-templates/` into the app, add the entries from
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx` to `shared-components/static-files.apx`, then run the apexlang gates.

## Use

On any region, set **Appearance > Template** to **AMC Folder Tab**. In APEXlang: `appearance { template: @amc-folder-tab }`.

Region template shaped like a file folder. The region title and icon sit on the folder tab; buttons in Help, Edit, Change, Copy, Delete and Create sit beside the tab, and Previous, Close and Next in the paper's footer. The body is a sheet of paper with a light grain and is never clipped or transformed, so report menus, date pickers and popups work normally. Template options: Primary, Success or Danger tab color the whole folder with that palette color and switch the tab text to its contrast color; Stacked papers shows two more sheets peeking out behind the paper; Ink outline gives folder, tab and paper a bold ink border with a hard offset shadow; No body padding lets reports run edge to edge. The tab lifts slightly on hover and focus except under prefers-reduced-motion; forced-colors mode draws plain system borders.

## Template options

| Option | Class | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Primary tab | `amc-TFolderTab--primary` | Folder and tab use the primary palette color; the title switches to the primary contrast color. Without a tab color the folder is manila, mixed from the warning color. |
| Success tab | `amc-TFolderTab--success` | Folder and tab use the success palette color, for approved or closed files. |
| Danger tab | `amc-TFolderTab--danger` | Folder and tab use the danger palette color, for escalations and blocked files. |
| Stacked papers | `amc-TFolderTab--stacked` | Two more sheets peek out at slight angles behind the paper, for files that hold several documents. |
| Ink outline | `amc-TFolderTab--ink` | Bold neo-brutal look: 2px ink borders on folder, tab and paper and a hard offset shadow. The ink follows the theme text color, so it inverts in dark styles. |
| No body padding | `amc-TFolderTab--noPadding` | Removes side padding so reports and grids run edge to edge on the paper. |
